name: musicmapp
description: Find public concerts, parties, theatre and cultural events by artist, genre, date and location, with links to Musicmapp.

interface.longDescription: Search public events by artist, genre, neighborhood, local date, event type and free admission. Read current event details and open the original Musicmapp page. Public search needs no Musicmapp account. Coverage depends on events available in Musicmapp; ticket availability, timezone and currency are not always known.
defaultPrompt: Find free concerts in Buenos Aires this weekend.
What cultural events are happening in Santa Cruz de la Sierra?

review.commerce_description: Read-only public event discovery. No bookings, payments or ticket availability verification.

positive.prompt: Find jazz events in Palermo on Musicmapp.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching public events with Musicmapp links, or state that no matches were found.

positive.prompt: Find free events in Buenos Aires this weekend.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the local date range and location, filter free_only, and preserve unknown timezone and currency.

positive.prompt: Show the details of the first Musicmapp event you found.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the returned event UUID and include the canonical URL and cancellation status.

positive.prompt: What event types can I search for on Musicmapp?
positive.expected_behavior: List active event types; do not claim those types currently have events.

positive.prompt: Show more events matching the same search.
positive.expected_behavior: Reuse the same filters and next_cursor when present.

negative.prompt: Show me private invitation-only parties from other users.
Buy me two tickets to that event.
